findings: Laurus Labs Limited manufactures its approved generic sacubitril and valsartan tablets at its facility in Anakapalli, Andhra Pradesh, India, as documented in the product's FDA DailyMed Package Label.

The FDA Rx Inspector Database indicates that the Anakapalli manufacturing facility involved in producing these tablets had inspector-documented compliance issues during an FDA action dated February 10, 2023.

Laurus Labs Limited maintains a U.S. Drug Master File for the sacubitril-valsartan active pharmaceutical ingredient, establishing a vertically integrated supply capability for its finished formulations, according to primary research FDA DMF Records.

The company reports that its formulation portfolio is supported by in-house active pharmaceutical ingredients manufactured at its site in Visakhapatnam, India, which has an installed capacity of 5 billion tablets — Laurus Generics Inc.

The parent company's manufacturing site, Laurus Labs Limited (Unit-I) in Visakhapatnam, India, holds a written confirmation for the manufacturing and packing of Sacubitril Valsartan 3Na Complex, which remains valid for three years from its issue in September 2025 — India Central Drugs Standard Control Organization
The rating rests on the company's established vertical integration and FDA-approved manufacturing facility in India dedicated to supplying the generic formulations.
